# Copilot Instructions for AddictedProxy

**This file is superseded by [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** — the repository's
canonical agent instructions (the cross-agent `AGENTS.md` standard).

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for:

- the mandatory `coding-philosophy` skill (DRY > SOLID > KISS) and loading order,
- repository layout and build/test commands,
- unit + e2e testing best practices and CI gates,
- Conventional Commits and PR workflow,
- the `docs/` and `.agents/skills/` indexes.

GitHub Copilot reads `AGENTS.md` natively; this file exists only as a
backward-compatibility pointer and must not diverge from `AGENTS.md`.

<!-- skilld -->

Before modifying code, evaluate each installed skill against the current task.
For each skill, determine YES/NO relevance and invoke all YES skills before proceeding.
